channel.title: Khalil Charfi - Portfolio Updates
channel.description: Latest projects, publications, and updates from Khalil Charfi.

item.title: Portfolio Website Launched
item.description: Launched a new multilingual portfolio website showcasing my engineering approach, projects, and professional experience.

item.title: CHECK24 Bicycle Insurance Portal
item.description: Context: Germany's leading insurance comparison platform serving 2M+ monthly users. Challenge: Legacy PHP/Drupal templates caused slow checkout load times and redundant data steps. Contribution: Refactored the frontend into decoupled Vue.js components and integrated 8+ REST APIs. Outcome: Decreased page load times from 4.2s to 2.1s, boosting checkout conversion rates by 12%.

item.title: Cover 3D Mobile (ASM)
item.description: Context: B2B interior design and order-management application deployed to 500+ clients. Challenge: Sales agents in remote regions with unstable internet connections faced frequent order losses. Contribution: Designed a CouchDB/PouchDB offline-first synchronization and data replication model. Outcome: Enabled 100% offline functionality, reducing order data synchronization errors to zero.

item.title: 3andi & 3andi Partner (ASM)
item.description: Context: Multi-tenant loyalty and digital reward applications for North African merchants. Challenge: Paper-based rewards led to high verification overhead and slow customer retention loops. Contribution: Developed Flutter client apps featuring secure QR verification and Firestore listeners. Outcome: Supported 20K+ concurrent users and increased repeat customer visits for vendors by 25%.

item.title: Business Mobility Suite (ASM)
item.description: Context: Offline-first inventory and sales automation tools for retail networks. Challenge: Real-time stock discrepancies between sales reps and central warehouse databases. Contribution: Built Flutter/Ionic synchronizers and scalable Laravel REST API backends. Outcome: Reduced server load by 40% and eliminated sales synchronization discrepancies entirely.

item.title: Public Transportation App (MyBus)
item.description: Context: Real-time transit navigation and scheduling application serving Sfax. Challenge: Processing noisy live GPS streams from 15+ bus lines while keeping mobile data usage low. Contribution: Designed a GraphQL data caching pipeline and integrated Mapbox GL JS map renderers. Outcome: Delivered live ETAs to 50K+ commuters daily with a proven 92% ETA accuracy rate.
